name: Norfolk
registryBasis: Norfolk City’s Real Estate Assessor says it maintains city land records including parcel boundaries, and the City GIS Bureau publishes an official ArcGIS polygon parcel layer. This verifies a local parcel-record custodian and a public geometry candidate; a bounded feature query timed out without HTTP response, so no sample is claimed.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Two bounded requests timed out before any HTTP response; retain the transport failure and do not infer source absence.
scopeLimits: Research is limited to the exact unchanged WUP locator and reviewed local official sources. No owner, address, tax-account, private property, credential, or token values were requested or retained. No citywide completeness or legal-title claim is made.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide coverage, source currentness, legal title and survey accuracy remain unverified; no full parcel geometry was retained.

officialSources.observation: City Real Estate Assessor states it maintains land-record information including parcel boundaries.
Official City GIS page describes interactive mapping applications and an informational-use disclaimer.
Public City GIS metadata describes a city parcel polygon feature layer and supports JSON/GeoJSON; only the safe OBJECTID was specified in attempted bounded queries.

research.geometryReview: Public polygon layer metadata verified, but no geometry sample retained: bounded MapServer and FeatureServer requests around the unchanged WUP point both timed out at 12 seconds with no HTTP status. Geometry is therefore an unverified candidate, not an absence claim.
